runner:
"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-7dch. Each mutant replaces every occurrence of
`old` with `new` in one file of a fresh `git archive <commit>` extraction
(node_modules symlinked from the worktree), then runs the sweep record's
test file there. Killed only when it replaced at least one occurrence, vitest
exits nonzero, and its output names the expected failing test."""
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

REPO = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
COMMIT = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
SUBJECT = "apps/three-surface-poc/src/keyboard-sweep-record.ts"
TEST = "apps/three-surface-poc/src/keyboard-sweep-record.test.ts"
MISSING = "refuses a page whose walkthrough evaluation identity is missing, duplicated or not an identifier"
MOUNTS = "refuses mounts that agree on the footer but disagree on the walkthrough evaluation identity"
MUTANTS = [
    ("M1", "duplicates accepted",
     "  if (walkthrough.length !== 1) return { refused: `expected one walkthrough evaluation identity",
     "  if (walkthrough.length === 0) return { refused: `expected one walkthrough evaluation identity",
     MISSING),
    ("M2", "a missing identity defaulted instead of refused",
     "  if (walkthrough.length !== 1) return { refused: `expected one walkthrough evaluation identity, found ${walkthrough.length}` };\n"
     "  const walkthroughEvaluationIdentity = unescapeHtml(walkthrough[0]![1]!);",
     "  if (walkthrough.length > 1) return { refused: `expected one walkthrough evaluation identity, found ${walkthrough.length}` };\n"
     "  const walkthroughEvaluationIdentity = walkthrough.length === 0 ? 'pwb-unrecorded' : unescapeHtml(walkthrough[0]![1]!);",
     MISSING),
    ("M3", "identifier grammar dropped",
     "  if (!WALKTHROUGH_IDENTITY.test(walkthroughEvaluationIdentity)) return",
     "  if (false) return",
     MISSING),
    ("M4", "the run record's identity stands in for the expected binding",
     "\\sdata-polaris-readiness-expected-evaluation(",
     "\\sdata-polaris-readiness-(?:expected-)?evaluation(",
     MISSING),
    ("M5", "mounts disagreeing on the walkthrough identity accepted",
     "    } else if (binding.walkthroughEvaluationIdentity !== first.binding.walkthroughEvaluationIdentity) {",
     "    } else if (false) {",
     MOUNTS),
    ("M6", "the record omits the walkthrough identity",
     "    walkthroughEvaluationIdentity: input.evaluation.walkthroughEvaluationIdentity,\n",
     "",
     "names the task, the Butlers revision and the evaluation identity beside each mount digest"),
    ("M7", "--out still creates docs/evidence",
     "  return { file, directory: dirname(file) };",
     "  return { file, directory: join('docs', 'evidence') };",
     "writes to --out and creates only its directory"),
]
subject_sha = hashlib.sha256(subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{COMMIT}:{SUBJECT}"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout).hexdigest()
test_sha = hashlib.sha256(subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{COMMIT}:{TEST}"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout).hexdigest()
archive = subprocess.run(["git", "archive", COMMIT], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
results = []
for mid, what, old, new, expect in [("M0", "control: unmutated", None, None, None)] + MUTANTS:
    tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"7dch-{mid}-"))
    try:
        subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(tmp)], input=archive, check=True)
        os.symlink(REPO / "node_modules", tmp / "node_modules")
        n = None
        if old is not None:
            target = tmp / SUBJECT
            text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            n = text.count(old)
            target.write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        run = subprocess.run(["npx", "vitest", "run", TEST], cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = run.stdout + run.stderr
        tests_line = next((l.strip() for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith("Tests")), None)
        if old is None:
            results.append({"id": mid, "description": what, "exitCode": run.returncode, "testsLine": tests_line, "passed": run.returncode == 0})
            continue
        results.append({"id": mid, "description": what, "file": SUBJECT, "old": old, "new": new, "occurrencesReplaced": n,
                        "command": f"npx vitest run {TEST}", "expected": expect, "exitCode": run.returncode,
                        "killed": n >= 1 and run.returncode != 0 and expect in out,
                        "outputMatch": next((l.strip() for l in out.splitlines() if expect in l and "FAIL" in l), None),
                        "testsLine": tests_line})
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
mut = [r for r in results if r["id"] != "M0"]
print(json.dumps({"commit": COMMIT, "subjects": [{"path": SUBJECT, "sha256": subject_sha}, {"path": TEST, "sha256": test_sha}],
                  "results": results, "killed": sum(r["killed"] for r in mut), "total": len(mut)}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
